name: starflask_generate_video
description: Create a Starflask video generation job. Returns a job id immediately — poll with starflask_get_job until status is 'completed', then read result.video_url. Pass the request as the `payload` object using the structured form: {"structured_data": {"model_key": "<key>", "params": {...}}}. Text-to-video: model_key "kling-text2video" with params {"prompt": "...", "duration": 5}. Image-to-video (animate a still): model_key "kling-img2video" with params {"image_url": "<url from starflask_upload_media or a prior image job>", "prompt": "...", "duration": 5}. Use starflask_list_models to see available video models and their input_schema.

payload.description: The video generation request, e.g. {"structured_data": {"model_key": "kling-text2video", "params": {"prompt": "...", "duration": 5}}} for text-to-video, or model_key "kling-img2video" with params {"image_url": "...", "prompt": "..."} to animate an uploaded image.
